SELECT Genre.Name, SUM(InvoiceLine.Total) AS Revenue
FROM InvoiceLine
JOIN Invoice ON Invoice.InvoiceId = InvoiceLine.InvoiceId
JOIN Customer ON Invoice.CustomerId = Customer.CustomerId
JOIN Artist ON Customer.Company = Artist.ArtistId
JOIN Album ON Artist.ArtistId = Album.ArtistId
JOIN Track ON Album.AlbumId = Track.AlbumId
JOIN PlaylistTrack ON Track.TrackId = PlaylistTrack.TrackId
JOIN Playlist ON PlaylistTrack.PlaylistId = Playlist.PlaylistId
JOIN Genre ON Playlist.Name = Genre.Name
GROUP BY Genre.Name
ORDER BY Revenue DESC;

SELECT Artist.Name, COUNT(InvoiceLine.TrackId) AS NumberOfTracksSold
FROM Artist
JOIN Invoice ON Artist.ArtistId = Invoice.CustomerId
JOIN InvoiceLine ON Invoice.CustomerId = InvoiceLine.InvoiceId
GROUP BY Artist.ArtistId
ORDER BY NumberOfTracksSold DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    MONTH(INVOICE_DATE) AS Month,
    (SUM(TOTAL) - (IFNULL(CURRENT_MONTH, 0) * 1000000000)) AS RevenueChange
FROM 
    Invoice
GROUP BY 
    MONTH(INVOICE_DATE)
ORDER BY 
    MONTH(INVOICE_DATE) ASC;

SELECT Name, (Total * 100) / (SUM(Total) OVER (PARTITION BY GenreId) AS Percentage
FROM InvoiceLine
JOIN Invoice ON InvoiceLine.InvoiceId = Invoice.InvoiceId
JOIN Track ON InvoiceLine.TrackId = Track.TrackId
JOIN Genre ON Track.GenreId = Genre.GenreId
GROUP BY Track.MediaTypeId, Track.GenreId, Track.Name, Track.MediaTypeId, Track.GenreId, Track.Composer, Track.Milliseconds, Track.Bytes, Track.UnitPrice
ORDER BY Percentage DESC;

SELECT Artist.Name, AVG(Milliseconds / 1000) AS AverageMinutes
FROM Artist
JOIN Album ON Artist.ArtistId = Album.ArtistId
JOIN Track ON Album.TrackId = Track.TrackId
WHERE Artist.ArtistId IN (
    SELECT ArtistId
    FROM Artist
    JOIN InvoiceLine ON Artist.ArtistId = InvoiceLine.ArtistId
    GROUP BY Artist.ArtistId
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
)

SELECT 
    e.LastName, 
    e.FirstName, 
    m.LastName AS ManagerLastName
FROM 
    Employee e
LEFT JOIN 
    Employee m ON e.ReportsTo = m.EmployeeId
WHERE 
    e.EmployeeId IS NOT NULL;

FROM Invoice
GROUP BY InvoiceDate, Month(InvoiceDate)
ORDER BY Month(InvoiceDate) ASC;

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM countries;
SELECT name FROM countries WHERE region = 'South Asia';
SELECT capital_city FROM countries WHERE iso3 = 'JAPAN';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM countries WHERE income_group = 'Low income';
SELECT population FROM country_stats WHERE iso3 = 'IN' AND year = 2023;

SELECT name, population
FROM countries
WHERE year = 2023
ORDER BY population DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT name, gdp_per_capita_usd
FROM countries
WHERE year = 2023
ORDER BY gdp_per_capita_usd DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT year, population
FROM country_stats
GROUP BY iso3, year
ORDER BY year;
SELECT name FROM countries WHERE region = 'Sub-Saharan Africa' AND life_expectancy_years > 70;

SELECT country_stats.year, country_stats.unemployment_pct
FROM country_stats
WHERE iso3 = 'DE'
ORDER BY year ASC
LIMIT 8;

SELECT region, AVG(fertility_rate) AS average_fertility_rate
FROM countries
JOIN country_stats ON countries.iso3 = country_stats.iso3
WHERE year = 2023
GROUP BY region;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM country_stats WHERE gdp_usd > 1000000000000;

SELECT country_stats.iso3, country_stats.fertility_rate
FROM countries
WHERE region = 'Europe & Central Asia'
AND year = 2023
ORDER BY fertility_rate ASC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT year, gdp_usd FROM country_stats WHERE iso3 = 'US' AND year IN (2000, 2023);

SELECT region, AVG(internet_users_pct) AS avg_internet_usage
FROM countries
WHERE year = 2023
GROUP BY region
HAVING AVG(internet_users_pct) > 70;
SELECT population FROM country_stats WHERE iso3 = 'CHN' AND year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2023;

SELECT name, gain
FROM countries
JOIN country_stats ON countries.iso3 = country_stats.iso3
WHERE year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2023
ORDER BY gain DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT income_group, gdp_usd
FROM countries
JOIN country_stats ON countries.iso3 = country_stats.iso3
WHERE year = 2023
ORDER BY gdp_usd DESC;

SELECT iso3, name, region, income_group, capital_city
FROM countries
WHERE year = 2023
AND gdp_per_capita_usd > (SELECT AVG(gdp_per_capita_usd) FROM country_stats WHERE iso3 = countries.iso3)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS country_count
FROM countries
WHERE year = 2023
AND population < (SELECT population FROM country_stats WHERE iso3 = (SELECT iso3 FROM countries WHERE name = 'Country Name' AND year = 2010));

SELECT name, region, life_expectancy_years
FROM countries
WHERE year = 2023
AND life_expectancy_years < 60;

SELECT region, (population / (population + urban_population_pct)) * 100 AS percentage
FROM countries
JOIN country_stats ON countries.iso3 = country_stats.iso3
WHERE year = 2023;
SELECT * FROM countries WHERE income_group IS NULL AND year = 2023;

SELECT year, (gdp_usd - gdp_usd_prev_year) / gdp_usd * 100 AS percentage_growth
FROM country_stats
WHERE iso3 = 'FRANCE'
ORDER BY year;

SELECT income_group, name, gdp_per_capita_usd
FROM countries
WHERE year = 2023
ORDER BY gdp_per_capita_usd DESC;

SELECT region, 
       MEDIAN(population, urban_population_pct) AS median_value
FROM countries
WHERE region IN ('Europe & Central Asia', 'Sub-Saharan Africa')
AND year = 2023
GROUP BY region;

SELECT iso3
FROM countries
WHERE iso3 IN (
    SELECT iso3
    FROM country_stats
    WHERE year = 2010 AND internet_users_pct < 10
    AND iso3 IN (
        SELECT iso3
        FROM country_stats
        WHERE year = 2023 AND internet_users_pct > 50
    )
)

SELECT region, name, population
FROM countries
JOIN country_stats ON countries.iso3 = country_stats.iso3
WHERE year = 2023
ORDER BY population DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT region, name, unemployment_pct
FROM countries
JOIN country_stats ON countries.iso3 = country_stats.iso3
WHERE year = 2020;

SELECT region, year, (SELECT AVG(life_expectancy_years) FROM country_stats WHERE iso3 = country_stats.iso3) AS average
FROM countries
JOIN country_stats ON countries.iso3 = country_stats.iso3
WHERE country_stats.region = countries.region
GROUP BY region, year;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM penguins;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM penguins WHERE species = 'Gentoo';
SELECT island FROM penguins;
SELECT body_mass_g FROM penguins ORDER BY body_mass_g DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM penguins WHERE sex IS NULL;
SELECT AVG(flipper_length_mm) AS average_flipper_length FROM penguins;

SELECT species, AVG(flipper_length_mm) AS average_flipper_length
FROM penguins
GROUP BY species
ORDER BY average_flipper_length DESC;
SELECT island FROM penguins ORDER BY body_mass_g DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT species, sex, AVG(body_mass_g) AS average_body_mass
FROM penguins
WHERE sex IN ('male', 'female')
GROUP BY species, sex;
SELECT sex, COUNT(*) AS count FROM penguins WHERE island = 'Biscoe' AND species = 'Gentoo' GROUP BY sex;

SELECT species, year, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM penguins
GROUP BY species, year
ORDER BY species, year;
SELECT island FROM penguins GROUP BY island HAVING COUNT(island) > 1;

SELECT species, island, body_mass_g
FROM penguins
WHERE flipper_length_mm > (SELECT MAX(flipper_length_mm) FROM penguins)

SELECT species, AVG(body_mass_g) AS avg_2007, AVG(body_mass_g) AS avg_2009
FROM penguins
WHERE year IN (2007, 2009)
GROUP BY species;

SELECT species, island
FROM penguins
WHERE bill_length_mm > (
    SELECT AVG(flipper_length_mm) 
    FROM penguins
)

SELECT 
    rank() OVER (PARTITION BY species ORDER BY bill_length_mm) AS rank,
    species,
    bill_length_mm
FROM 
    penguins;

SELECT FirstName, LastName, Total
FROM Customer
ORDER BY Total DESC
LIMIT 3;
